video_title: EXCLUSIVE: Jeremy Lin opens up about his relationship with Carmelo Anthony

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on his transition into the NBA broadcasting space
quotes.excerpt: I was able to establish report with Malika, with Hillary Guy and even with some of the other analysts.
quotes.quote: A couple months ago, I was able to go to LA, be on NBA Today for three days and was able to establish report with Malika, with Hillary Guy and even with some of the other analysts. So a big shout out to Perk, Kendrick Perkins and Windhorst who really welcomed me and they were just super nice and Malika was and still is an amazing host and the ultimate point guard on TV essentially. So I'm just excited to reunite with them and to be able to talk Knicks and to be able to talk the Finals.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin recalls the intense energy of the Garden
quotes.excerpt: The Garden was so loud that I genuinely, legitimate I looked down at my feet to see if I was hovering.
quotes.quote: I remember vividly in the game against Kobe and the Lakers, the Garden was so loud that I genuinely, legitimate I looked down at my feet to see if I was hovering because it felt like I was hovering a half inch off the ground because it was so loud and the energy was so hyped. And so it felt like I was actually off the ground a little bit and I'll never forget that because it almost felt like an out of body experience.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin reflects on the disappointment of his 2012 injury
quotes.excerpt: I've waited my whole life for this opportunity. Linsanity happens and how gut wrenching it was to not be on the floor.
quotes.quote: For me, I am hyper competitive. I've waited my whole life for this opportunity. Linsanity happens and how gut wrenching it was to not be on the floor and to not be able to compete. I don't think very many people can truly understand that unless you have been in that position before or something close to that. And so that was just really disappointing to me, but injuries are a part of basketball and so that's just something that it will always be a huge what if in my mind.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on wanting a private conversation with Carmelo Anthony
quotes.excerpt: I would love to have a private conversation before having a public, you know, recorded conversation.
quotes.quote: I think for me right now, and I know our teams are in contact, and I think for me I've just been, my desire is still kind of the same. I would love to have a private conversation before having a public, you know, recorded conversation. And so that's my goal right now is to be able to have that private conversation and would love to of course, you know, go on a podcast and talk about those things and talk about certain things publicly afterwards.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on why score-first point guards can win championships
quotes.excerpt: Score-first point guards can win championships and have proven to do that and have won many championships.
quotes.quote: As the game has evolved, I think that's more and more where things are trending, whether it is a Steph or a Kyrie, these types of score-first point guards. And I think it's all about who is next to them, who they're being paired with. Steph worked great because of Klay and Draymond and even KD for two of the championships. Steph is a Hall of Famer and one of the best point guards ever to play the game. And same with Kyrie. And so with Brunson, they let Brunson do what Brunson is elite at, which is scoring, which is taking over games and putting the ball in the hoop.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on how Jalen Brunson targets specific defensive matchups
quotes.excerpt: He probably won't want Castle and Wemby. Not to say that he can't score on them.
quotes.quote: Generally speaking, he probably won't want Castle and Wemby. Not to say that he can't score on them, he can and I'm sure he will at times, but is that the most favorable matchup for him? Probably not. I do think Fox and Champagnie will maybe be two of the people that he goes after. Vassell might be in there and even a Harper. But to me, it's not he may not only isolate one specific person as it is maybe more of I'm going to stay away from those two specific players.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on the Knicks' consistency and elite mentality
quotes.excerpt: It's easily the consistency and consistency comes down to character and mentality.
quotes.quote: It's easily the consistency and consistency comes down to character and mentality. To me, they have shown high character and high elite mentality. They are not a team that refuses to show up on certain nights. They are not a team that gives up when things are going wrong or when things are difficult. They have won 12 in a row because they treat each game and have respect for each game as if it's a new challenge.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on the importance of trust and sacrifice for the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: There is a pre-existing relationship amongst a lot of their core, so there is that internal trust.
quotes.quote: There is a pre-existing relationship amongst a lot of their core, so there is that internal trust. And you add in other pieces and they are building trust, I think that's very important. There's another part where these players are walking the walk when it comes to sacrifice. Brunson giving up $113 million, that is walking the walk and that carries into everybody. Everybody has to show up a certain way when your best player is walking the walk.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on the Spurs' defensive execution in Game 1
quotes.excerpt: The timing of when they pass that ball out was so perfect and so fast.
quotes.quote: The first half and the second half to me wasn't that different in terms of game plan. I just don't think they were expecting Fox, Castle, Harper to get rid of the ball that quickly. And one of the things that struck me from the first half was San Antonio's the timing of when they pass that ball out was so perfect and so fast. And then Champagnie is quick release and so it's not that guys were in the wrong position, I just think they needed a little bit of time to adjust to how quick that ball was going to be fired out.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on how the Spurs can better utilize Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: They definitely have to involve Wemby in much more creative actions, too much isolation.
quotes.quote: They definitely have to involve Wemby in much more creative actions, too much isolation. And I don't think Wemby isolating on Cat is going to, it may work for a game or two, but it's not going to work for the whole series. It's not going to win a championship off of that matchup. I think that's a little bit too tough, so they're going to have to find ways to get Wemby in closed out situations where he is able to attack whoever is guarding him, not just one-on-one with all the help defense set and staring at him.
